experience.description: Participating in a prestigious, nine-month scholarship program focused on coding, design, and business skills within the iOS ecosystem. Employs a challenge-based learning approach to develop world-class applications.

Architected SIGAP, an advanced system that collects and analyzes news data in real time. Integrated Ollama AI and Llama 3.2 prompting to streamline information retrieval, improving analysis speed by up to 40%. Built high-performance backend APIs reducing overall data processing overheads by 30-50% while supporting real-time parsing of over 1,000 news articles monthly.

experience.company: Bangkit Academy by Google, GoTo, Tokopedia, Traveloka
experience.description: Completed extensive curriculum specializing in Deep Learning, Mobile Development, and Cloud Architecture. Built machine learning pipelines using TensorFlow and Keras, implementing predictive models that achieved 92% real-world accuracy. Graduated with Distinction, ranking in the top 10% of the entire cohort.

Led operations for AIESEC Future Leaders. Increased initiative profitability by 75% over a 12-month period, far exceeding original forecasts. Managed customer satisfaction metrics with a remarkable average score of 9.7/10.
